key.name: endpoint-url
key.description: Full URL of the whisper.cpp server's inference endpoint. The shipped default is the route an unflagged whisper.cpp server serves. Deployments started with --inference-path serve a different route instead.

key.name: response-format
key.description: Which format new transcriptions start in. The main window overrides this for the current session without changing the default. These five strings are the literals the server branches on; anything else falls through to json.

key.name: destination-directory
key.description: Absolute path of the directory transcripts are saved into. Empty means unset, in which case Shoki resolves the XDG Documents directory plus a Transcriptions subfolder at runtime. Empty rather than a baked-in path so the setting travels between machines with different home layouts.

key.name: no-timestamps
key.description: Only affects the srt and vtt formats. Sent to the server as the no_timestamps form field.

key.name: split-on-word
key.summary: Split subtitle lines on word boundaries
key.description: Only meaningful when max-len is greater than zero: it decides whether a length-limited segment breaks at a word or mid-token. Sent to the server as the split_on_word form field.

key.name: max-len
key.summary: Maximum subtitle segment length in characters
key.description: Zero means no limit, which is the server's own default. Only affects the srt and vtt formats. Sent to the server as the max_len form field.

key.name: color-scheme
key.description: Whether Shoki follows the system light/dark preference or forces one. Applied through AdwStyleManager.
